proposals.description: Operational metrics including timing and token usage are not being recorded in review_facts
proposals.rationale: This prevents proper monitoring and optimization of the extraction pipeline's performance
proposals.proposed_action: Add metric logging to the review_facts function in extract_pipeline.py to capture timing and token usage data

proposals.description: Activity log body is missing faithfulness scores, retry history, and unfaithful fact lists
proposals.rationale: This information is essential for debugging and evaluating extraction quality and reliability
proposals.proposed_action: Update activity_log.body serialization to include faithfulness scores, retry counts, and unfaithful fact lists

proposals.description: MCP intent classification mismatch for turn_id 4fa75004-1e15-427d-913b-057a6967ed04 - extracted 'report' but expected 'other'
proposals.rationale: This indicates potential model misclassification that could affect downstream processing
proposals.proposed_action: Review and retrain MCP intent classification model for better accuracy on report-related intents

proposals.description: MCP intent classification mismatch for turn_id d668e495-97cc-4d6c-af68-8d0da61d0978 - extracted 'report' but expected 'request'
proposals.rationale: This inconsistency suggests model confusion between similar intent categories
proposals.proposed_action: Analyze training data and retrain MCP model to better distinguish between 'report' and 'request' intents

proposals.description: Incomplete extraction for turn_id d5ec4da3-06a5-452b-9247-e8e3ec517a61 - user input 176ch, assistant response 249ch with missing facts
proposals.rationale: This suggests extraction quality issues that may impact downstream applications
proposals.proposed_action: Investigate extraction logic for long-form content and implement better fact capture mechanisms

proposals.description: MCP entity correctness issue for turn_id d5ec4da3-06a5-452b-9247-e8e3ec517a61 - entity extraction problems in de_mod_pipeline.py
proposals.rationale: Entity extraction errors can lead to inaccurate data processing and downstream failures
proposals.proposed_action: Review entity extraction logic in de_mod_pipeline.py to improve accuracy for code-related entities

proposals.description: Low extraction coverage for short turns - user input '1+1 답만 해줘' (9ch) with limited extraction results
proposals.rationale: Short turns may be underperforming due to insufficient context for extraction
proposals.proposed_action: Implement context-aware extraction for short turns to improve coverage and accuracy

proposals.description: Inconsistent tagging for turn_id 4fa75004-1e15-427d-913b-057a6967ed04 - tags include 'greeting' and 'welcome'
proposals.rationale: Tagging inconsistencies may affect categorization and filtering of conversation turns
proposals.proposed_action: Standardize tagging approach and ensure consistent tag assignment across similar conversation patterns

proposals.description: Model discrepancy in extraction results - 2 out of 4 extractions failed on 3B model requiring 30B fallback
proposals.rationale: This indicates model performance variability that may affect reliability
proposals.proposed_action: Analyze failure patterns and implement better model selection or fallback mechanisms

proposals.description: review_facts.verdict가 'pending'에서 절대 갱신되지 않음 — downstream pipeline이 review_facts를 UPDATE하지 않음
proposals.rationale: This prevents the system from properly tracking review status, causing a critical data consistency issue where pending reviews never transition to completed states.
proposals.proposed_action: Identify and fix the downstream pipeline that should update review_facts.verdict from 'pending' to 'completed' or 'rejected' based on review outcome.

proposals.description: enqueue_review()가 queue_status 항상 'reviewed'로 고정 — P-R-J bypass
proposals.rationale: This bypasses the proper queue management logic, causing all reviews to be marked as 'reviewed' regardless of their actual processing state.
proposals.proposed_action: Modify queue_writer.py line 23 to correctly set queue_status based on actual review processing state instead of hardcoding 'reviewed'.

proposals.description: LLM 클라이언트가 API 응답에서 token usage/timing을 추출하지 않음
proposals.rationale: Missing token usage and timing data prevents proper monitoring, billing, and performance optimization of LLM calls.
proposals.proposed_action: Update lib/llm_client.py to parse and extract token usage and timing information from API responses.

proposals.description: fact_index가 일관성 없음 — mcp_meta가 extract_model='Qwen30B'로 별도 row 저장
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent fact_index handling leads to data integrity issues where facts are stored in separate rows, making retrieval and processing unreliable.
proposals.proposed_action: Fix extract_pipeline.py line 550 to ensure consistent fact_index handling across all extract_model types, avoiding duplicate or separate row storage.

proposals.description: MCP entity 파일 경로 검증이 절대 경로 변환 없이 직접 join
proposals.rationale: Direct path joining without normalization can lead to path traversal vulnerabilities and unexpected file access patterns.
proposals.proposed_action: Update extract_pipeline.py line 170 to use os.path.normpath() or similar normalization before joining paths to prevent path traversal issues.

proposals.description: 27B verify가 timing/token 정보를 전혀 수집하지 않음
proposals.rationale: Missing timing and token data for 27B verify makes it impossible to track resource usage or optimize performance for this model.
proposals.proposed_action: Modify review_consumer.py call_verify_model() lines 133-161 to capture and log timing and token usage information for 27B verify operations.

proposals.description: Hardcoded API keys in configuration file
proposals.rationale: Exposes sensitive credentials in version control and creates security vulnerabilities
proposals.proposed_action: Move API keys to environment variables or secure configuration management system

proposals.description: SQL injection vulnerability in user input handling
proposals.rationale: Direct concatenation of user input into SQL queries allows malicious SQL execution
proposals.proposed_action: Implement parameterized queries or ORM with proper input sanitization

proposals.description: Inefficient database queries with N+1 problem
proposals.rationale: Multiple database round trips for related data causes significant performance degradation
proposals.proposed_action: Use eager loading or batch queries to reduce database round trips

proposals.description: Missing input validation on file upload endpoint
proposals.rationale: Allows arbitrary file uploads which can lead to remote code execution
proposals.proposed_action: Implement strict file type validation and sanitize uploaded filenames

proposals.description: Duplicated code blocks across multiple controller methods
proposals.rationale: Code duplication makes maintenance harder and increases risk of inconsistencies
proposals.proposed_action: Extract common logic into reusable service methods or base controller

proposals.description: Unoptimized image processing pipeline
proposals.rationale: Inefficient image resizing and processing without caching leads to high CPU usage
proposals.proposed_action: Implement image caching and use optimized processing libraries

proposals.description: Missing CSRF protection in form submissions
proposals.rationale: Vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery attacks
proposals.proposed_action: Add CSRF tokens to all state-changing forms and validate them

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions in JavaScript files
proposals.rationale: Makes code harder to read and maintain across different developers
proposals.proposed_action: Enforce consistent naming conventions using ESLint or similar tooling

proposals.description: Large JavaScript bundle without code splitting
proposals.rationale: Increases initial load time and bandwidth usage for users
proposals.proposed_action: Implement code splitting and lazy loading for non-critical JavaScript

proposals.description: Missing documentation for public API endpoints
proposals.rationale: Makes it difficult for external developers to understand and use the API
proposals.proposed_action: Add comprehensive API documentation using tools like Swagger or Postman

proposals.description: Insecure password storage using plain text hashing
proposals.rationale: Passwords stored without proper salting or hashing algorithms make them vulnerable to rainbow table attacks
proposals.proposed_action: Use bcrypt or similar industry-standard password hashing with proper salt generation

proposals.description: N+1 query problem in user profile endpoint
proposals.rationale: Each user profile triggers additional database queries for related data, causing exponential performance degradation
proposals.proposed_action: Implement eager loading or batch queries to fetch related data in single database round trips

proposals.description: Race condition in transaction processing
proposals.rationale: Multiple concurrent transactions can corrupt data due to lack of proper locking mechanisms
proposals.proposed_action: Implement database-level locking or use atomic operations for transaction consistency

proposals.description: Duplicated code blocks in authentication service
proposals.rationale: Code duplication increases maintenance burden and introduces inconsistency risks
proposals.proposed_action: Extract common authentication logic into reusable utility functions or service methods

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions across modules
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent naming makes code harder to read and maintain across different developers
proposals.proposed_action: Enforce consistent naming conventions (camelCase, snake_case) throughout the codebase

proposals.description: Unnecessary database queries in loop iteration
proposals.rationale: Repeated database calls within loops cause performance bottlenecks and increased latency
proposals.proposed_action: Batch database operations or use query optimization techniques to reduce round trips
